senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Obsequial, funeral.
n. (-कं)
Obsequies of a deceased person; whatever is given or performed on a person's decease, as burning, offering cakes, giving [] alms, &c.
E.
ऊर्द्ध or ऊर्द्ध्व above, देह the body, and ठक् affix; hence also और्द्ध्वदेहिक.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
A Śaiva or adherent of that doctrine^1, which gives ŚIVA the pre-eminence in the Hindu triad.
E.
ऊर्द्धश्रोतस् a name of ŚIVA, viz. above whom or in whose head is the river, (-श्रोतस्) (the Ganges,) and ठक् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.
